conversations.answer: [CODE_BLOCK_0]This script achieves the goal by first moving and renaming the Tailwind CSS configuration file, then updating both the PostCSS and Vite configurations to point to the new location and name of the Tailwind CSS configuration file.Since we're using a CommonJS syntax (.cjs extension), we're using require() to import modules instead of the import keyword, and module.exports instead of the export keyword.The script makes sure to keep the project running as intended by preserving the relationships and dependencies between the moved and renamed files and the ones that depend on them.
